bio: On the shores of Lac de Miers, close to the Salmière spring, this restaurant boasts a bucolic setting with its terrace jutting out over the water. In the dining room with its floor-to-ceiling windows, warm tones and white timber rafters, guests are treated to seasonal, colourful and inventive cuisine. The chef subtly pays tribute to the terroir (Quercy lamb, Carennac green lentils) and introduces original combinations, such as mango piperade with the fish of the day or a strawberry-rhubarb floating island.
